meta: What is overfitting? A student memorizes old exams and fails the new one. AI makes the same mistake, called overfitting.

muc.title: Memorized and still failed
muc.text: A student memorizes the answers to old exams and fails the new one. AI makes this mistake too; it's called overfitting.

muc.title: Remembering useless details
muc.text: Overfitting is when a model fits its examples too tightly, remembering useless details instead of the real pattern.

muc.title: Dogs always on grass
muc.text: If AI only sees dogs on grass, it thinks grass means dog, and gets a dog on sand wrong.

muc.title: Varied examples
muc.text: When you give AI examples, give a few different kinds, not copies of one.

muc.title: One example, three examples
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to write a customer greeting from one example, then from three different examples.

thu: Ask a chatbot to write a customer greeting from one example, then from three different examples, and compare.
